author: reek
body: The cleanup wear-off: marked damage AND until-end-of-turn power/toughness modifications both leave the permanents. Every writer of power-mod and toughness-mod in this engine (pump spells, firebreathing, combat tricks, attack-trigger self-pumps) is an until-end-of-turn effect; durable P/T comes from the template plus the continuous layers (anthems, auras, tribal), which are computed at read time and never touch the mods.
